why_choose_us.title: Fujitsu Elite Contractor, 2024
why_choose_us.description: Awarded for the level of factory training our staff hold on ductless equipment — a credential most contractors in NEPA are not certified to carry.

why_choose_us.title: Repair first, replace only when it's warranted
why_choose_us.description: If your system can be fixed, we tell you so, even though a replacement is worth more to us. One customer wrote that three other companies got the diagnosis wrong before we did.

why_choose_us.title: The estimate is the price
why_choose_us.description: You get a written scope and a number before we start. Customers have written that the final cost was within the estimate and there were no additional charges or fees.

why_choose_us.title: Heating, cooling and plumbing, one contractor
why_choose_us.description: A boiler, a mini-split and a leaking water heater are one phone call, not three. Licensed and insured in Pennsylvania, PA #091633.
